Record Class McpCaller

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
grafioschtrader.mcp.McpCaller
Record Components:
idUser - the owner of the access token
idTenant - the home tenant of that user; a token never reaches another tenant
idUserAccessToken - the token that authenticated the request
scope - what the token may do
locale - the locale of the user, for translated messages
language - the language of the user, for multilingual names
localeStr - the locale string the reports expect
today - the current day in the client's time zone
zoneId - the client's time zone, from the header x-time-zone, otherwise UTC
public record McpCaller(Integer idUser, Integer idTenant, Integer idUserAccessToken, AccessTokenScope scope, Locale locale, Language language, String localeStr, LocalDate today, ZoneId zoneId) extends Record
Everything a tool needs to know about who calls it, built once when the tool is entered and passed down to every report. The tool beans are singletons and never hold a user object themselves.

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object).
      Specified by:
      equals in class Record
      Parameters:
      o - the object with which to compare
      Returns:
      true if this object is the same as the o argument; false otherwise.
